description_en: Creates an advanced site monitoring task
description_zh: 创建站点监控专业版任务
kebab_example: aliyun cms create-task --address http://www.aliyun.com --task-type 1 --task-name aliyunTest --interval 1 --isp-city city_:_546_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_572_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_738_,_isp_:_465 --options http_method_:_get_,_header_:_xx=bb_,_cookie_:_test=aa_,_time_out_:30000,_match_rule_:0,_response_content_:_aa --alert-rule example-string --alert-ids example-string --caller example-string --interval-unit example-string --api-version 2018-03-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTask

parameters.help_en: The address to be monitored, such as http://www.aliyun.com
parameters.name: address

parameters.help_en:
http
ping
tcp
udp
dns
smtp
pop3
ftp
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the monitoring task. The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length and can contain letters and Chinese characters
parameters.help_zh: 监控的任务名4-50位中英文字符
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The detection frequency. Valid values: 1, 5, and 15. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 探测频率，取值范围1、5、15，单位是分钟
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The information about the detection points. You can call the DescribeISPAreaCity operation to query the detection point information
parameters.help_zh: 探针的信息，需要从DescribeISPAreaCity 接口获得
parameters.name: isp_city

parameters.help_en: The advanced extended options for the monitoring protocol
parameters.help_zh: 监控对应协议的高级扩展选项
parameters.name: options
